title: He got rejected by Microsoft 😓  #openai #chatgpt #microsoft
description:
When Microsoft rejected this developer, he took the ultimate revenge: he built a better, faster version of Excel that runs entirely inside the computer terminal.

While modern spreadsheet applications have become bloated with heavy interfaces and unnecessary background processes, this lightweight alternative strips away the noise. It features a retro, 1980s-style command-line interface, but underneath the hood, it is built for pure performance. It natively handles massive datasets, supports formulas, manages complex cell formatting, and opens standard Excel files instantly on almost any machine.

In this video, we dive into how this terminal-based spreadsheet tool works, why power users are claiming it outperforms mainstream software, and how one developer turned a career setback into a brilliant engineering triumph.


#SoftwareEngineering #IndieHacker #VibeCoding #ClaudeOpus #OpenSource
